notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 – Tutorial & UI Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1

Fixed an issue with the Defeat UI displaying incorrectly.
Fixed a tutorial mission bug: players will now correctly receive the mission to buy units from the blacksmith NPC before the first defense mission.

notes.title: Upcoming Tutorial Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[p]Bug description:
A tutorial mission is currently being skipped by accident. This does [b]not[/b] stop overall game progression, but it may cause some confusion.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players need to purchase defensive units at the [b]Blacksmith NPC[/b] before they can be deployed in battle.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Defeated” UI is also not displaying properly.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve already fixed this issue, but due to a Steam security lock the patch won’t be available until early next week.[/p][p]✅ Players can still progress through the game normally — just remember to purchase defensive units before starting [b]Reina’s mission[/b]![/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience and support.
[/p][p]— StarFlow Studio[/p]
